title: "Re-Tell the Fortune so I Can Believe It": How Chinese User Communities Engage with and Interpret GenAI-based Fortune-Telling
reasoning: The paper investigates the use of GenAI for fortune-telling and divination, which are spiritual and metaphysical practices. It explores how users derive spiritual meaning from AI, engage in 'mystical' belief formation, and handles a dedicated section on the ethical considerations and dilemmas of AI providing guidance on sensitive life matters.
